source: NLRB General Counsel memoranda GC 23-02 and GC 25-05

claims.claim: GC 23-02, issued 31 October 2022, addressed electronic monitoring and algorithmic management of employees and their impact on Section 7 rights
GC 23-02 was rescinded on 14 February 2025 in GC 25-05, among 29 memoranda withdrawn at once by the Acting General Counsel
claims.canonicalWording: Twenty-nine, not thirty-one. One track carried 31 before the first library pass.

cautions: Rescission of guidance is not repeal of doctrine — the underlying Section 7 analysis survives the memorandum. Same shape as the EEOC guidance withdrawal in ai101-m7.
